nombre: fuerza y suma vectorial con la pasita delantera

hobby.detalle: la Pasita, delantera y capitana en una final de fútbol con viento

arte.universo: An original women's football (soccer) world on a windy, rainy night: a glowing stadium with tall floodlights, a wet green pitch with white lines, rain streaks and swirling leaves that make the wind visible, corner flags and fan flags whipping in the wind, a cozy club locker room with wooden benches, lockers and a tactics board. The Pasita is the team captain and striker: purple kit with a sky-blue captain armband, football boots, the PASAS raisin emblem inside a circle on the chest. Forces appear as glowing translucent arrows on the pitch (sky-blue for the kick, golden for a tailwind, pink for a headwind). Teammates and rivals are simple round generic characters (not the Pasita, not existing players), in plain kits with no numbers, no letters and no crests from real clubs. No text, digits or letters anywhere in the image.

post:
¿La suma de fuerzas no te entra? Piénsala como un tiro con viento: a favor se junta a tu disparo, en contra te lo quita. ⚽💨

Así se explica en PASAS: cada tema con lo que te gusta (videojuegos, anime, K-pop o fútbol).

La última lámina es tu acordeón: guárdalo para tu examen de física.
